title: Joint frames on dual-suffix strips: conditional κ = 4.75073569e-5
body:
This composes PR #55's dual-suffix scalar graphs with PR #57's joint frame compiler, giving

$$
T(n)=O\left(n(\log n)^{1-\kappa}\right),\qquad
\kappa=\frac{475073569}{10^{13}}=4.75073569\times10^{-5}>2^{-15}.
$$

The conditional exponent saving is **1.740964% above #57** (`4669442391/10^14`). The exact bit saving is `1187740349/25000000000000`. The inherited analytic and fixed finite-alphabet multitape hypotheses still apply.

## Construction

The pinned PR #55 graph computes each leave-one-out strip by the dual-suffix identity

$$
s_j=(A_{j-1}+v_{j+1})+B_{j+2},\qquad s_k=A_{k-1}.
$$

PR #57's compiler groups nodes sharing an original rational envelope, synthesizes invertible binary maps within each region, and reclaims retired signal components using explicitly paid XOR gates. Applying it to the dual-suffix graph reduces the physical role counts:

| Quantity | PR #57 | This PR |
|---|---:|---:|
| h=23 auxiliary roles | 31,416 | **30,790** |
| h=25 auxiliary roles | 41,264 | **40,446** |
| Physical wires W | 153,481,944 | **150,593,466** |

The two complete wrapped words contain **474,786 / 629,356** elementary XORs, including all signal-clearing operations. Both orientations restore every arbitrary dirty auxiliary. The common I+J bases, all 4,073,300 data pairs, copied centers, paid endpoints, complex branch, and assembly interfaces are retained. No extra paid-clone graph is used.

The total rank is **86,589,396,050**, the deficit remains **1,846,900**, and the maximum child width is **529**. The complete PR #57 child list has exact lower moment greater than one at the new bit saving.

## Verification status

**Full `make verify` passed** at the original construction commit `bc2f7ed4c20dc18898305ab17165c0c995cbb804`: **246 integrated tests**, every retained and new producer/profile/data check, and **20 historical patch checks**, with no generated-file drift. All **17 GitHub checks** also passed on that exact construction, including the inherited historical and Gaussian formal packages. These formal checks do not formalize the new exponent proof. The [original completion receipt](https://github.com/chafreaky/integer-mult-bounds/blob/96c52fb81cab6e714768e00ca33ca7f004ebcac4/certificates/joint-dual-repository-validation.json) is preserved unchanged.

Current head `be5d3e6e39ad9a11372f168e37466af412e51e53` merges main through `d55bcd62ceb8f322bcf311a5a66e94c3ac7724f0` additively. It retains all historical research files, all 28 `verify-research` recipes, the expanded `make verify`, and all six Python CI groups. Only the README/Makefile source pins and their derived certificate digests changed; the exponent, all arithmetic, producer sources, physical words and profiles are unchanged.

Fresh integration verification passed **all 28 research producers, 419 integrated tests, 20 patch checks, and the community follow-up arithmetic**. Complete joint-dual regeneration again reproduced both words, every dirty basis and exact CRT profile, 47 strict inequalities and seven assembly margins. The final focused rerun was byte-clean on the current head. Independent integration/publication review passed; the original independent review included **22 adversarial controls**. Current source manifest: `70bfb892d14521162a1ee7b89b5458f1575a9734776487d433e4477c1b50f0a8`.

The prior complete construction run and the new scoped integration checks are separate evidence. **All 20 GitHub checks passed on the current head**, including all 18 Python matrix jobs and both inherited formal packages. The PR is ready for review and mergeable against `d55bcd6`.

```sh
make joint-dual-verify
make verify-research
make verify-tests
make community-followup-check
# Complete repository reproduction:
make verify
```

The [local proof](https://github.com/chafreaky/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bc2f7ed/research/joint-dual/PROOF.md) and [exact certificate](https://github.com/chafreaky/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bc2f7ed/certificates/joint-dual-kappa.json) include the finite argument and remaining general obligations. The branch retains the PR #57 baseline at `cd350f7` and includes current main through `d55bcd6`.

Finite checks do not prove the inherited all-size residual compiler, framed-word transfer, finite-alphabet tape layout, analytic, routing, prime-selection, or exact-recovery obligations. This is not a formal proof, a global optimality claim, or a measured runtime speedup.
